environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-13 policy candidate; deterministic manager judgment, task-wide CAS retry, revision, stop/force and full-termination fixtures

items.evidence: Fixtures bind worker first-level judgment to the exact task/revision/run, completion criteria, immutable artifact paths and collected/current hashes; success, failure, exit-zero criteria failure and insufficient evidence produce distinct Manager outcomes.

Fixtures admit recovery attempts one through three, block a fourth, exclude initial and normal-improvement attempts, preserve usage across revision/settings/commit/name changes, require exact durable CAS plus post-read, and impose no elapsed-time cutoff.

Mutation, a new worker instruction and relaunch remain absent until the complete managed lifetime, descendants, input return and control return are confirmed ended; stop request or main return alone is insufficient.

Manager plans reconcile worker evidence, approved scope, current authority, retry state, automation state and terminal ownership, and produce evidence-rich additional-investigation or blocked reports for malformed, unknown, out-of-scope or exhausted cases.

A new revision is deferred to the next run by default; current-run application requires stop and full termination before approved mutation and relaunch, while revocation immediately closes authority and settings changes preserve the running experiment and retry usage.

Force requires an owner-attested ordinary stop bound to the exact run and target, a strictly later coherent managed-running observation, delegated identity/ownership and fresh TargetLiveness=true; force is blocked for unknown/stale/drifted or terminated states and a later full-termination observation is required before follow-up actions.
